topics.name: Bell Pepper Bacterial Classification
topics.description: Detect bacterial damage on bell pepper.

Week 1: Introduction to Bell Pepper Bacterial Classification and its agricultural impact.
Week 2: Explore dataset directory structure and labeling format.
Split dataset into train, validation, and test sets.
Reflection, limitations, and ethical AI discussion.
Week 3: Perform exploratory data analysis on 2475 images across 2 classes.
